1.title: I Asked A Marketing Genius What Actually Makes People Buy
1.author: Simon Squibb
1.hook: Rory Sutherland (Ogilvy, 40 years) on brand psychology: how to make offers easy to accept, why trends spread, memorability, naming strategy, differentiation vs. competition, premium positioning.

2.title: Rory Sutherland: The Surprising Power of Irrational Leadership | HR4Leadership 2026
2.author: Srdjan Vukcevic | Gentle Provocation
2.hook: Rory Sutherland on psychological reframing as competitive advantage—psychology as the abandoned variable, pricing as perception (Nespresso, Pampers), reframing problems (range anxiety vs. waiting), reverse benchmarking (Buc-ee's, Eleven Madison Park), and why founder-led businesses outperform on bold bets.

1.title: He built a personal AI Chief of Staff with OpenClaw
1.author: How I AI
1.hook: CTO built a multi-agent system (OpenClaw) that handles approvals, email triage, food ordering, travel, and smart home automation; covers soul files and subagent architecture, guardrails design, and cost tradeoff between GLM 5.3 Flash (~local) vs Anthropic ($500–600/month).

2.title: AI Will Soon Generate New Movies Live in Your Living Room
2.author: MTS
2.hook: Reactor CEO discusses PixVerse R2 (real-time world model for interactive generation), robotics integration with Runway ML, and how Hollywood studios are using live generation to let audiences explore existing franchises—moving from passive video generation to interactive experiences.
